nodes.name: L4 enabled?

parameters.query:
SELECT p.id, p.uid, p.body, p.purpose, p.media_uid, p.published_at,
       COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN threads_comments c ON c.post_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 'published'
  AND p.published_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  AND p.purpose IN ('product', 'persona')
GROUP BY p.id, p.uid, p.body, p.purpose, p.media_uid, p.published_at
HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 0
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: Fetch posts with comments
nodes.notes: Get published posts from last 7 days that have comments

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.comment_id, c.text, c.username, c.post_id, c.created_at,
       EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM l4_replies r WHERE r.comment_id = c.comment_id) AS has_reply
FROM threads_comments c
WHERE c.post_id IN ({{ $json.posts.map(p => p.id).join(',') || '0' }})
  AND c.created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO l4_replies (post_id, comment_id, comment_text, intent, reply_text, reply_comment_id, psychology_techniques, status, persona_calibrated, published_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::text[], 'published', $8, now())
ON CONFLICT (comment_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = 'published',
  reply_comment_id = EXCLUDED.reply_comment_id,
  published_at = now();

notes:
L4 On-Post Reply Engagement Loop

Checks for unreplied comments every 4 hours, classifies intent, drafts replies with psychology techniques, passes QA gate, and publishes to Threads.

To enable: UPDATE settings SET value = jsonb_set(value, '{enabled}', 'true') WHERE key='l4_reply';

Rate limits: 10 replies/day, 5 per post, 24h cooldown per user (configurable in settings.l4_reply)
